# Calendar 1.2.1

This update expands the offline assistant and makes English the default language
for new installations. Existing language choices and calendar data are preserved.
The app displays **Calendar** in English and **Kalendarz** in Polish.

## What's new

- Reschedule saved, non-recurring events with a before/after preview and explicit confirmation.
- Get a proposed replacement time when meetings conflict.
- Choose preferred planning hours, weekdays, and buffers between events in Settings.
- Search using common Polish word endings, English plurals, and selected calendar-related equivalents.
- Plan 2–20 sessions as a complete batch, with one session per available preferred day.
- Undo the last assistant operation during the current app session, including a batch save.
- Use assistant commands in English and Polish, with follow-up questions for missing dates or times.
- Correct an event draft conversationally, such as “actually one hour later”.
- Request accurate weekend, week, and month summaries and duration-aware free slots.

Every proposed calendar change requires confirmation. Batch saves are atomic.
Stale previews and undo requests refuse to overwrite subsequent edits.
Recurring series remain editable in the event editor so their scope and exceptions
are not changed implicitly. Undo history does not survive an app reload.
All assistant processing remains local; no language-model download or cloud account is required.

## Downloads

- **Android:** `Kalendarz-Offline-1.2.1-android-test.apk` — installable test APK signed with an Android development key; not a Google Play release.
- **Windows x64:** installer (`*-setup.exe`), portable executable (`*-portable.exe`), and ZIP. These files do not have a commercial Authenticode signature.
- **Linux x64:** AppImage and Flatpak (requires the Flathub runtimes).
- **Web/PWA:** `Kalendarz-Offline-1.2.1-web.zip` for HTTPS hosting. Open the app online once to enable offline use.
- **Integrity:** `SHA256SUMS.txt` contains checksums for all seven platform packages.

Export a calendar backup before upgrading. Android cannot update an existing APK
signed with a different key; uninstalling the previous app deletes its local data.
Notification delivery and camera behavior on physical phones still depend on device
permissions, battery policies, and hardware.
